name: compteEtudiant
description: Compter le nombre de noeuds Etudiant

name: compteRelation
description: Compter le nombre de relations CONNAIT

name: toutSuppr
description: Supprimer tous les noeuds et relations

name: statFiliere
query:
MATCH (e:Etudiant)
RETURN e.filiere AS filiere,
       count(e) AS total,
       sum(CASE WHEN e.consomme_cannabis THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consommateurs,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN e.consomme_cannabis THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(e), 1) AS pct
ORDER BY pct DESC;

name: top10Popu
query:
MATCH (e:Etudiant)-[:CONNAIT]->()
RETURN e.id, e.filiere, e.logement, count(*) AS degree
ORDER BY degree DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: projectionGDSsocial
description: Projeter le graphe en memoire - requis avant tout algorithme GDS

name: EcrirePR
description: Calculer et ecrire le PageRank sur chaque noeud

name: dropProjection
description: Supprimer la projection de la memoire GDS
query:
CALL gds.graph.drop('graphe_sociale')
YIELD graphName, nodeCount, relationshipCount;

name: topInfluenceur
query:
MATCH (e:Etudiant)
RETURN e.id, e.filiere, e.logement,
       round(e.pagerank, 4) AS pagerank,
       e.consomme_cannabis
ORDER BY pagerank DESC
LIMIT 15;

name: GDSlouvain
description: Detecter les communautes avec l'algorithme de Louvain

name: louvainCOMM
query:
MATCH (e:Etudiant)
RETURN e.communaute,
       count(e) AS taille,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN e.consomme_cannabis THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(e), 1) AS pct_cannabis
ORDER BY taille DESC
LIMIT 20;

name: ponts_comm
description: Calculer la Betweenness Centrality - ponts entre communautes

name: voisinageCons
description: Voisinage d'un consommateur connu a 2 sauts - remplacer S0001
query:
MATCH path = (seed:Etudiant {id: 'S0001'})-[:CONNAIT*1..2]-(voisin:Etudiant)
WHERE voisin.id <> seed.id
RETURN DISTINCT voisin.id,
                voisin.consomme_cannabis,
                length(path) AS distance
ORDER BY distance, voisin.consomme_cannabis DESC;

name: tauxLouvain
description: Taux de consommation par communaute Louvain
query:
MATCH (e:Etudiant)
WITH e.communaute AS com,
     count(e) AS n,
     sum(CASE WHEN e.consomme_cannabis THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conso
WHERE n >= 5
RETURN com,
       n,
       conso,
       round(100.0 * conso / n, 1) AS pct_cannabis
ORDER BY pct_cannabis DESC;
